title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteer Night at Convoy of Hope
description: This is a Giving Tuesday volunteer event at Convoy of Hope's headquarters, where volunteers mostly count, sort, and box or bag product, then help clean up their work area. It is for ages 10 and up; youth 10-12 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and children under 10 are not eligible. Registration is required, and volunteers need closed-toe shoes and a current liability waiver on file. It takes place Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 PM at the Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center, One Convoy Drive, Springfield, MO.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
